criteria: Not present in this note at all
Barely present - mentioned once, in passing
Present strongly - the note dwells on it
Dominant - the note is largely about this
question.instructions: How strongly does the note praise the quality of the finish itself, not just its length (e.g., 'lingers beautifully', 'glides', 'concentrated finish', 'long, refined finish') versus giving the finish no notable positive treatment?

standard_answer.note:
因为关于 finish 只有一句：
“a tight apple skin finish”

这确实带有一定正面描述，但只是简短提到一次，没有像 “long, refined finish” 或 “lingers beautifully” 那样明显赞美收尾质量。
所以最合适的是 Barely present。
